plugin_fixtures.generator: a cut of the bundled file to the corpus's keys
plugin_fixtures.cut: `pLI_values.txt`: the header and the rows of the bundled `pLI_values.txt` (Ensembl VEP_plugins, Apache License 2.0) whose gene symbol a transcript of the pruned cache carries, the symbol SOD1 respelled `Sod1`; `pLI_transcript_values.txt`: the header and the rows of `tests/fixtures/plugins/pLI_transcript_values.txt` (the chromosome 21 transcripts of the ExAC release 0.3 constraint table, the stable id without its version) that the pruned cache carries, SOD1's transcript respelled `enst00000270142`; the respellings exercise the case-insensitive match of both engines, and the manifest's run reads the whole bundled file beside Ensembl VEP's module through `--dir_plugins {plugins}` while vep-rs reads the cut through the same flag, so the two runs write the same rows

vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh37 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --stats_text --quiet --force_overwrite --dir_plugins {plugins} --plugin pLI [--tab|--vcf|--json]
input: 33 gnomAD v2.1.1 genome records on chromosome 21 (dbSNP identifiers where the release carries one; INFO dropped), one or two in the canonical transcript of each chosen gene (an exonic substitution and, where the records offer one, an exonic indel): TPTE, LIPI, APP, SOD1, TTC3, DYRK1A, DSCAM, RUNX1, KCNJ6, SETD4, CXADR and HUNK, which the pLI file and the LoFtool file of tests/golden/116/GRCh37-plugin-loftool, a corpus over the same records, both list; GABPA, LTN1 and TMPRSS15, which the pLI file lists and that LoFtool file does not; one gene neither file lists (AL050302.1); and one intergenic record more than 5,000 bases from any transcript. The scores reach the output in every shape the plugin prints: two decimals from `0.00` (TPTE, 5.11e-31) to `1.00` (DSCAM) and, under `sigfig`, three significant figures from `5.11e-31` to `1`.
generator: manifest: tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly GRCh37 --dataset plugin-pli=<reference over the candidate records>=candidates.vcf --k 3 --seed 1 --include <each record's name> --covers pLI --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--dir_plugins --flag={plugins} --flag=--plugin --flag=pLI, then flag-set for each flag_sets entry and classify for the manifest's run and each flag set; json_cache: scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice of the vep-rs JSON conversion of the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh37 cache; plugin_data: the cut described under plugin_fixtures; expected outputs: scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --dir-plugins <VEP_plugins checkout> for the manifest's run and, per flag set, for a copy of the corpus carrying the set's flags as its own, whose outputs and record are the set's

values-file.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh37 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --stats_text --quiet --force_overwrite --dir_plugins {plugins} --plugin pLI,{corpus}/plugin_data/pLI_values.txt [--tab|--vcf|--json]
